sources.title: The Cruel Song – Who Was Karmein Chan?

question.value: Who was the last person outside the family to see Karmein Chan alive?
Were the phone lines cut?
What do we really know about Karmein Chan’s behavior during the home invasion?
Did the abductor know that Karmein had asthma?
Is there any evidence that Karmein Chan was taken to the same hideout as the other victims?
What was the exact distance between the abduction site and the place where her body was found?
Why did the perpetrator choose to kill Karmein, when previous victims had been released?
What was the likely route taken by the abductor between Templestowe and Edgars Creek?
Who are the witnesses or acquaintances today who might be willing to speak, or cooperate anonymously?
What did the place where Karmein was held prisoner look like, exactly? Is a reconstruction possible?
Was Mimi a dog or a cat (or something else)?
Did the abductor steal anything from the Chan residence (clothing, records, money…)?
Was Mimi present inside the Chan residence during the abduction?
If Mimi was a dog and was present at the Chan residence during the abduction, why didn’t he/she bark?
What was her favourite music (artist, track, composer…)?
What was her favourite TV show?
What was her favourite movie?
What was her favourite toy?
What was her favourite activity?
What was her favourite sport?
What was her favourite animal?
What was her favourite colour?
What was her favourite fruit?
What was her favourite food?
What was her favourite place?
What were her familiar expressions?
Was she into video games?
Where did she go to practice skating?
Was she taking ballet/dance lessons?
Were John Chan's reported commercial disputes over unpaid restaurant fit-outs ever investigated as a possible alternative motive?

review_flags: Based on alleged, unverified, second-hand hearsay. Publication hold: neutral wording only, no implication of guilt; do not name creditors or tradespeople.

question.value: How long did Karmein Chan stay at the February 1991 PLC camp near Jerusalem Creek, and on which exact dates?

review_flags: KCSRC00058 is an auto-transcript (faster-whisper); verify wording against the audio.
The site's dates (2–17 February 1991) are an unsourced author estimate; KCSRC00058 says only 'the first two weeks of school' and refers to 'camps' (plural).

question.value: Where was the PLC Year 8 coordinator's statement about the 1991 camps at Jerusalem Inlet (quoted in KCSRC00058) originally published?

review_flags: KCSRC00058 is an auto-transcript (faster-whisper); verify wording against the audio.
Single, unnamed source relayed second-hand by the podcast; do not name the coordinator.

question.value: Did police investigate a possible link between the February 1991 Eildon camp and the reported Alexandra sightings?

review_flags: KCSRC00058 is an auto-transcript (faster-whisper); verify wording against the audio.

The Alexandra sightings are unverified reports by two unnamed witnesses (KCSRC00078, The Age, 25 August 1991, page 1, 'Karmein: recent photo prompts new clues'). The camp–offender link is explicitly labelled speculation in KCSRC00058 (38:38–39:09). Neutral wording only; no implication about any person.

question.value: Which campsite or facility did PLC use near Jerusalem Creek in 1991?

review_flags: KCSRC00058 is an auto-transcript (faster-whisper); verify wording against the audio.

KCSRC00058 names both 'Jerusalem Creek' and 'Jerusalem Inlet'; Parks Victoria lists eight Jerusalem Creek camping areas along Jerusalem Creek Road (KCSRC00079, current description, not evidence for 1991).

question.value: When and where was the birthday party footage of Karmein Chan filmed, and is "the weekend before the abduction" documented?

review_flags: KCSRC00080 is an auto-transcript (faster-whisper) and the hosts speak from memory; verify wording against the audio.

Only KCSRC00080 dates the party ('the weekend before the abduction', i.e. about 6–7 April 1991, a calculation) and places it ('I believe in Brighton or Brighton East'). KCSRC00081 shows the footage without any date or place. KCSRC00082, as read in KCSRC00080, mentions the godparents but not a party.
Private individuals (other children, the host family, the godparents) must not be identified.

question.value: Who first broadcast the birthday party footage (channel, programme, date), and was it supplied by the family or by police?

review_flags: Earliest identified use: Nine, Under Investigation with Liz Hayes S3E4, 2 March 2022 (KCSRC00081), uncaptioned and uncredited. A 1991 TV news use is reported but not identified. KCSRC00080 (26:04) says listeners 'may recall footage', without a broadcast reference.
The ABC 1991 news reports reuse a different home-video shot (Karmein laughing by a car); do not conflate.

question.value: Did police examine the guests of this birthday party, or the footage itself?

review_flags: KCSRC00080 is an auto-transcript (faster-whisper) and the hosts speak from memory; verify wording against the audio.
No source found on any police examination of the party, its guests or the footage. Neutral wording only; no implication about any person.
Private individuals (other children, the host family, the godparents) must not be identified.

question.value: Where was the description of Karmein by her friends quoted on the home page ("a very friendly person with a strong personality who had a bubbly sense of humour and who lived life to the fullest") originally published?

review_flags: Quote not found outside The Cruel Song (web, Wikipedia, Reddit dump, Melbourne Marvels and Casefile transcripts); ProQuest check needed.

question.value: Where did William Mackay describe Karmein as "charming, polite, enthusiastic and lively"? The published variants found so far are "enthusiastic and positive" (Herald Sun, 16 April 1991, KCSRC00086, as read in KCSRC00075) and "a fairly reserved student" (KCSRC00085).

review_flags: KCSRC00086 is known only as read in KCSRC00075 (auto-transcript); original not consulted.
KCSRC00085 wording is the TCS Backstage press summary of The Age, 01/05/1991, p. 1; verify against the scan.
The site wording 'charming, polite, enthusiastic and lively' was not found in any source.

question.value: What did Karmein want to become? The claims to verify are a barrister (attributed by KCSRC00006 to KCSRC00018), a doctor or "mobile doctor" (KCSRC00083), and a paediatrician (KCSRC00056, a single anonymous source).

review_flags: 'barrister' is Wikipedia's (KCSRC00006) attribution to KCSRC00018, not checked against the original.
'paediatrician' rests on a single anonymous informant (KCSRC00056).
KCSRC00083 is read via a blog copy (KCSRC00028).

question.value: Did PLC publications (school magazine or yearbooks, 1990-1992) print any of Karmein's own writing, or a tribute to her in 1992?

review_flags: No writing by Karmein found; PLC archives and yearbooks are the realistic source.

question.value: What height and physical description of Karmein did Victoria Police publish in April 1991? The height currently shown (154cm) comes from an AI tool (KCSRC00024) and needs a primary source.

review_flags: KCSRC00024 is AI-derived (moderate risk of hallucination); replace with the April 1991 police description (press 14–16/04/1991).

question.value: Which source supports the claim that Karmein needed her inhaler "whenever she got too tired or emotional"?

review_flags: Wording 'too tired or emotional' not found in any source.
KCSRC00075 [auto-transcript, police statement as read]: 'she normally has a pump beside her bed'.
KCSRC00041: 'She can't get very tired.'

question.value: When did Karmein have glandular fever? The sources give September 1989 (KCSRC00018), "two years ago" (Herald Sun, April 1991, as read in KCSRC00075) and still recovering in April 1991 (KCSRC00018).

review_flags: Three versions: September 1989 (KCEVT0005, KCSRC00018); 'glandular fever two years ago' (Herald Sun as read in KCSRC00075, auto-transcript); recovering in April 1991 (KCSRC00018; Canberra Times 16/04/1991 p. 5, Trove 122357296, not catalogued).

question.value: Which subjects, house and co-curricular activities did Karmein take at PLC in 1990 and 1991?

review_flags: Only Year 8, class 8H and entry in 1983 are documented.

question.value: Which source documents the PLC memorial service at Scots Church on Wednesday 20 May 1992, and what was said about Karmein there?

review_flags: The site sentence on the memorial service carries no KCSRC; likely The Age of about 21/05/1992 (ProQuest check needed).

question.value: Where is Karmein's grave, and what exactly does its inscription say, according to a published photograph or cemetery record?

review_flags: Grave location and inscription known only from a Reddit transcription; cite a published photograph or cemetery record.
Do not publish visiting directions.

question.value: When was the 3AW recording of the funeral (KCSRC00050) broadcast, and does it include a eulogy describing Karmein?

review_flags: KCSRC00050 is undated with no URL; currently only cited for the choir hymn.

question.value: Which source supports the claim that Karmein watched Twin Peaks and was reading "The Secret Diary of Laura Palmer"?

review_flags: The site says 'reportedly' with no source; nothing found on the web or Reddit.

question.value: Which source supports the claim that Karmein used her pocket money to see The Phantom of the Opera musical, and in which year?

review_flags: No source; year uncertain.

question.value: Where and when was the "ski station" photo (KCSRC00023) taken, and did Karmein ski regularly?

review_flags: Only a photo caption ('Karmein Chan at the ski station'); see also KCQST0028 (skating).

question.value: Can a published source confirm that lasagne was Karmein's favourite dish (KCSRC00036, a single private message)?

review_flags: Single, non-disclosable private message; answers KCQST0024 only provisionally.

question.value: Which church did Karmein attend with her sisters before April 1991 (KCSRC00048), given her mother's account of converting from Buddhism to Christianity after the funeral (KCSRC00083)?

review_flags: KCSRC00048: the sisters sang a song learned in church with Karmein; KCSRC00083: mother's conversion after the funeral; the church is not named.

question.value: Does the original text of Karly's letter of 19 April 1991 (KCSRC00069, as read in KCSRC00077) say that Karmein helped her with her homework?

review_flags: Letter text known via a machine transcript of KCSRC00077; check against The Age, 20/04/1991, p. 1 (KCSRC00069).

question.value: Which Chinese language did Karmein study or speak? The home page lists Mandarin, but the Backstage summary of KCSRC00018 only mentions weekly "Chinese lessons"; given the family's Hong Kong origins (KCSRC00005), Cantonese is also possible.

review_flags: Backstage summary of KCSRC00018: 'Chinese (assuming Mandarin) lessons'.
KCSRC00005 p. 3: 'Both had moved to Australia from Hong Kong in the mid-1970s.' Cantonese is a possibility, not a documented fact.

question.value: Which primary sources support the facts about Karmein that the Knowledge File currently sources only to The Cruel Song itself (birth place, residences, Mandarin, year of death)?

review_flags: Circular sourcing (TCS-WWKC-WEB-0001 only).
Year of death 1991 is an inference: date of death unknown; remains found 09/04/1992.
